text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The High Court in northern Ndola town has summoned former president Kenneth Kaunda for questioning over his civil disobedience campaign.
- The Congress of Trade Unions said it had endorsed workers' right to strike once a dispute has been declared.
- Hundreds of residents in the southern town of Monze are homeless after heavy rains.
- The Zambia National Provident Fund is to be scrapped under a new pension scheme law.
- An opposition petition challenging President Frederick Chiluba's electoral victory in last November's elections will be heard by the Supreme Court on Monday.
